contentList.content: Frozen Heart
Legend speaks of those born from ice; cold to the touch and with a gaze that sends shivers down the spine. They say the crystals in your blood resonate with the Weave itself.
Icy Blood

The ice in your veins manifests in your magic. You permanently learn <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_RayOfFrost">Ray of Frost</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_IceKnife">Ice Knife</LSTag>.
Frozen Heart

Icy Blood

The crystals in your tissues resonate with the Weave itself. You permanently learn <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_ArmorOfAgathys">Armour of Agathys</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_CreateDestroyWater">Create or Destroy Water</LSTag>.
Icy Blood

They say your very soul is frozen to the touch. You permanently learn <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_FreezingSphere">Otiluke's Freezing Sphere</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Wall_WallOfIce">Wall of Ice</LSTag>.
Icy Skin

Your icy constitution protects you from the cold, but leaves you weakened by flame and easily broken by blunt force.

You are Resistant to[1] and Vulnerable to[2],[3],[4] and[5].
Icy Soul

Abuse your connection to ice and snow to cripple your foes.

When you deal[1] with spells, inflict [2] turns of Numbing Frost upon the target(s).
Numbing Frost
Affected entity has a -1 penalty to Constitution <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> per remaining turn. Stacks to [1] turns.

Improved Icy Soul
Your connection to the cold deepens. You add your Charisma <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Modifier</LSTag> to[1] from spells and are immune to cold-based conditions.

These conditions include: <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BRITTLE">Brittle</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHILLED">Chilled</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_FROST">Encrusted with Frost</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_FROSTBITE_CREATURE">Frostbitten</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_FROSTBITE_SPELL">Frostbitten</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_INCREASED_DAMAGE_COLD">Frostbite</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FROZEN">Frozen</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ICECLOUD">Ice Cloud</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_COLD_NUMBING_FROST">Numbing Frost</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAY_OF_FROST">Ray of Frost</LSTag>. You are also immune to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DIFFICULT_TERRAIN_ICE">Difficult Terrain</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE_ICE">Prone</LSTag> from ice surfaces.
You are <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistant</LSTag> to[1] and <LSTag Tooltip="Vulnerable">Vulnerable</LSTag> to[2].
When you deal[1] with spells, inflict [2] turns of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_COLD_NUMBING_FROST">Numbing Frost</LSTag> upon the target(s).
Difficult Terrain: Ice
Difficult terrain - <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">movement speed</LSTag> is halved and creatures may fall Prone.
Ice
Icy Soul II

You thrive in the cold. Gain immunity to cold-based conditions.

These conditions include: Brittle, Chilled, Encrusted with Frost, Frostbitten, Frostbitten, Frostbite, Frozen, Ice Cloud, Numbing Frost and Ray of Frost. You are also immune to Difficult Terrain and Prone from ice surfaces.

These conditions include: <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BRITTLE">Brittle</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHILLED">Chilled</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_FROST">Encrusted with Frost</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_FROSTBITE_CREATURE">Frostbitten</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_FROSTBITE_SPELL">Frostbitten</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_INCREASED_DAMAGE_COLD">Frostbite</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FROZEN">Frozen</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ICECLOUD">Ice Cloud</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_COLD_NUMBING_FROST">Numbing Frost</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAY_OF_FROST">Ray of Frost</LSTag>. You are also immune to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DIFFICULT_TERRAIN_ICE">Difficult Terrain</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE_ICE">Prone</LSTag> from ice surfaces.
Icy Blood

The innate chill in your blood allows you to cast spells more effectively.

Ray of Frost and Ice Knife can target an additional creature. You gain these spells for free.

<LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_RayOfFrost">Ray of Frost</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_IceKnife">Ice Knife</LSTag> can target an additional creature. You gain these spells for free.

If you have 5e Spells and/or Mystra's Spells installed, you are also immune to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FROSTBITE">Frostbite</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RIMES_BINDING_ICE">Rime's Binding Ice</LSTag>

If you have 5e Spells and/or Mystra's Spells installed, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Frostbite">Frostbite</LSTag> can also target an additional creature and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ShapeWater">Shape Water</LSTag>/<LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ShapeWater_Container">Shape Water</LSTag> now costs a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">bonus action</LSTag>.
Icy Blood II

The ice in your veins allows you to manipulate your magic.

When you become Wet, the water immediately freezes over and grants you Rime Shield. You also have Rime Shield while Armour of Agathys or Fire Shield: Chill
